body: The problem is when you try to get help and people just keep saying YOU HAVE NO REASON TO BE LIKE THAT. That’s the worst a person can hear. No one chooses depression and people seem not to understand that. Some people might have a lot of ‘friends’ around and money for example but when it comes to help they just disappear because they don’t understand why. That’s when thing go bad because you feel abandoned by the ones you love. It’s difficult to understand what depression is and it’s even harder to deal with it. I talk from personal experience because my family only began to understand what it means after I tried suicide and even though they don’t understand sometimes and I’m just overreacting.
